title: Closeout summary: Draft tier 2 execute-at-close gates behind a policy flag
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Created the tier 2 execute-at-close gates design note at docs/decisions/tier-2-execute-at-close-gates.md. The note keeps the feature proposal-only, records a default-off RuntimePolicy flag, restricts execution to checked-in declaredCommand strings, defines workspace-root cwd and current-process environment assumptions, requires bounded execution via runBoundedProcess, specifies auto-recorded command evidence, and documents failure semantics for non-zero exit, timeout, output cap, spawn failure, and expected-observable mismatch. Owner sign-off is recorded as design-note-only for this milestone; implementation still requires explicit owner acceptance before any implementation task is opened.

Close reason: Tier 2 execute-at-close design note completed; implementation remains gated on future owner sign-off.
